items.raw_excerpt: A dual British citizen is warning others to beware after the UK passport office lost her children's New Zealand passports.
items.summary_en: A woman with British and New Zealand citizenship says the UK passport office lost her children's New Zealand passports. She waited for weeks and no one could tell her what had happened. She says she could not care less, and she tells other families to keep a copy of their passport details at home.
